estimatePolicy: Every card has a <=4h planning cap including focused tests and review preparation, not an observed duration or promise. Split before claiming if the reviewed seam cannot fit. No blanket 4h full-scenario claim.
approvalGate: User approved written Choice A on 2026-11-11, including all 30 prerequisite cards and R1/R2/R3 packets. Approval is recorded release evidence outside the graph. Proposed cards remain unregistered and inactive until reviewed native registration and coordinated R3 activation; per-card requirements remain unchanged.
commonAcceptance: Preserve existing version semantics and history; additive changes only, migrations use actual fresh creation timestamps.
Strict typed inputs, safe integer arithmetic, parameterized SQL, no PII/oracle fields or secrets; functions/test callbacks/SQL bodies <40 lines, TS no any without approved rationale.
Critical paths have focused meaningful tests; source facts use authentic restricted writes with scoped service grants, publication/page receipts and authorized reads, never metric answer injection.
DB proof only isolatedPostgres runner-issued credentials, explicit target registration under locks, nonzero assertion counts and zero skipped/todo/pending.

One commit per independently verified change and one card PR. Independent review, latest-head CI and actual main merge precede Done. Existing authorized automatic deployment continues after reviewed green merges. Exclude manual production operations, credentials/grants changes, manual online migrations, real platform/LLM calls and external P07/P08 work.

Use DB SECURITY_UTC clock_timestamp() for grants, expiry, leases and deadlines; business time selects source visibility only. Under READ COMMITTED, lock generation, grant and membership in fixed order, repeat authority/expiry checks at the final write or capture, then commit. Revocation/reset obtains conflicting locks. Test both orderings and expiry during lock wait on two connections.

cards.title: Freeze observed-fact, causal-model and selection contracts
acceptance: Strict domain union, full binding/generation/subject/time/source-version/hash, bounded sizes, null versus verified zero and immutable receipt coverage rules.
Freeze causal producer ports, v3 config shape, publication commit/read protocol and authorized selection proof; no arbitrary payload or derived event-answer field.
proof: Parse valid domain samples and reject cross-scope references, unsafe values, future observations, extra/oracle fields and incomplete known-cost provenance.
outOfScope: Persistence, generator behavior, detector thresholds, service grants

cards.title: Store immutable observed facts and capability boundaries
acceptance: Typed domain constraints, unique generation/domain/fact/version identities, receipts and version-chain links; no direct UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE.
NOLOGIN capability roles, FORCE RLS, safe-login checks, fixed search paths, PUBLIC revocation; migration grants no existing production login.
proof: Disposable restricted logins prove cross-binding/generation denial, immutability, malformed payload rejection and operator-only provisioning.
outOfScope: Source publication, append API, capture or metric calculation

cards.title: Consume certified observed pages atomically

acceptance: Resolve and verify P03-035 immutable publication certificate; SQL checks exact certified records/coverage, full binding/generation, domain grant, lease/fence, cursor chain and publication availability.
Append facts, receipt and cursor in one transaction; current service/domain authority checked at commit; same-page replay returns original receipt, conflict/fork/stale fence fails.
proof: Real publisher/consumer grants, ten retries, old/new versions, injected rollback, revocation and generation reset; no fact or completeness receipt survives failed commit.
outOfScope: Causal business producers, observed reads, metric calculations

cards.title: Capture and read joined temporal observed sources
acceptance: Join immutable base revision and selected observed receipts/facts; hash full binding/generation/windows/cutoff/clock/model/coverage/comparison references.
First capture only at authoritative current business clock; immutable historic read revalidates current actor membership/generation. Optional base capture permitted only for source-health domains.
Late arrival, unknown domain and gaps never become complete or zero; bounded decode/overflow fails closed.
proof: Seal Day3, advance/append Day5 and replay identical Day3; backdated first capture denied; cross-tenant read, current revocation and changed generation denied.
outOfScope: Reconstructing unsealed historical base bundles or implementing business calculators

cards.title: Emit causal frozen finance observations
acceptance: Freeze versioned acquisition cost at actual payment; emit fee charges, settled refund allocations and accepted resellable-return receipts only when business events occur.
Conserve merchandise/shipping/refund/quantity values; return cost uses original frozen version; advertising fee has a single source charge identity.
Do not consume current selling price as cost or offline snapshot.economics; unavailable cost stays null.
proof: Payment then cost change, partial refund, no-return/late-return, nonresellable return, zero fee versus missing fee and duplicate event cases.
outOfScope: G4 formula changes, metric runtime activation, external settlement integration

cards.title: Generate visits before transactions and measured marketing
cards.contract: mock-business-observed-v1 demand transitions and measured coverage
acceptance: Versioned deterministic demand starts with visitor events, then cart/checkout/payment; order facts and SKU/store counters share causal transitions, never inferred inverse conversion.
Emit exact window measurements at close; explicit campaign eligibility/attribution policy and measured counters prove coverage. Store unique counts are not SKU sums.
Model accepts contract-owned supply/finance ports; no test labels, scenario IDs or expected event conditions in emitted facts.
proof: Same seed/config replay, price intervention changes observed progression, no payment without checkout, zero visitors versus unmeasured window, partial attribution and distinct-store counts.
outOfScope: Persistent publication registration, finance/inventory reducers, detector answers

cards.title: Emit listing, inventory-age and announced supply history
acceptance: Actual listing/price edges, conserved receipt and stock movements, remaining-lot quantity-weighted holding age, quarantine and inbound measurements.
Supplier notice records known promise and revised ETA when announced; future arrival schedule is not read as a current notice.
008 has no listing/history before T0; 006 has genuine surviving aged lots rather than fabricated dates.
proof: Old stock consumed then new receipt changes age; 90-day threshold; future notice excluded before announcement; real new listing cannot obtain prelaunch sales.

cards.title: Record business-time sync transitions independently of bundles
acceptance: Append observed FAILED/SUCCEEDED transition in its actual committed job-control transaction, including authoritative business time, fence, stream and known watermark; works before first page.
Map generic CONNECTOR_FAILED conservatively; typed errors only from actual pipeline result. No failure-rule input or raw provider text.
Authorized source-health read does not require four-stream capture; recovery appends rather than erases history.
proof: Real failed initial job yields persisted observation without normal bundle; page rollback followed by failure transition; later recovery cannot appear at earlier cutoff; revoked worker fails.
outOfScope: Treating DB downtime as a durable observation, failure-oracle projection, event publication

cards.title: Map selected observed receipts into metric inputs
acceptance: Map confirmed finance, traffic, campaign coverage and inventory extensions from authorized selected receipt sets; keep listing/lot/notice projection references for event assemblers.
Singleton subject/window coverage requires all relevant domains; retain all evidence IDs/input revision; unknown and complete empty are distinct.
Leave createNormalizedMetricSourceAdapter and old manifests unchanged.
proof: Wrong subject, mismatched receipt hash/version/cutoff, future return/notice and absent domain fail; exact measured zero is accepted only with proof.

cards.title: Calculate exact SKU sales, refund cohort and conversion

SKU traffic calculator requires matching ScopedMetricInputV1 selection proof and complete measured denominators; old STORE funnel behavior is untouched.
Unsupported SKU fees/advertising allocations remain explicit unavailable.

outOfScope: SKU campaign ROAS or proportional fee allocation, detector rules, production registry selection

Consume P03-033 transaction-bound atomic writer for immutable scalar/components/residual and both capture references. Never rebuild companion from a newer source.
No sum allocation to SKU without source proof; unallocated operating changes stay residual, and residual plus components exactly equals delta.
proof: Volume/price/mix/cost/advertising counterfactual inputs, changed cost version, shipping/refund/accepted returns, missing cost, misaligned weekday and visibleAt rejection.

Real restricted publisher->commit->capture->compute->snapshot proof includes receipt and full generation linkage; old v1 path remains compatible.
proof: Restricted PG real source->capture->metric snapshot roundtrip; missing capability or coverage, generation change and old-definition replay.

Check actual measured, complete same-W frame prerequisites for all three 015 issues, paired seasonal/twin windows, genuine launch absence before T0, and original observation watermarks for mature refund baselines.
